supporting_ids: s2:Asymmetry in the atmosphere of the ultra-hot Jupiter WASP-76 b
rationale: The paper on WASP-76 b investigates the atmospheric asymmetry of an ultra-hot Jupiter, which relates to the thermal phase shift and heat transport in exoplanet atmospheres, but does not provide a resolution to the question posed.
